text: Over the coffee machine, a coworker mentions a rooftop garden a few streets away that stays open in the evenings.
A flyer pinned by the counter advertises a reading night at Paper Lantern Books, just around the corner.
Music drifts over the water. Someone on the next bench says it comes from The Low Tide, a bar tucked under the bridge.
The same person as on your last two evenings sits at the end of the counter, and tonight they ask whether you are waiting for someone. (Placeholder: the chance route's first meeting.)
A neighbour taping a poster above the mailboxes tells you the lantern festival at the Harbour Night Market is next week.
